long: ON HALLOWEEN NIGHT, THE HAUNTED ANCIENT CASTLE OPENS FOR A QUIET VISITOR CARRYING A LANTERN.
A BRAVE OPERATOR CROSSES THE ANCIENT CASTLE AFTER DARK, WHILE OWLS WATCH FROM THE SILENT TREES.
WHEN THE CLOCK STRIKES MIDNIGHT, A SHADOW LEAVES THE ANCIENT CASTLE AND FOLLOWS THE CANDLELIGHT HOME.
THE OLD ANCIENT CASTLE STAYS EMPTY UNTIL A DISTANT BELL RINGS THREE TIMES THROUGH THE AUTUMN FOG.
WE FOLLOW A TRAIL OF CANDY PAST THE ANCIENT CASTLE, HOPING THE FRIENDLY GHOST WILL GUIDE US HOME.

WHEN THE CLOCK STRIKES MIDNIGHT, A SHADOW LEAVES THE SPOOKY OLD LIGHTHOUSE AND FOLLOWS THE CANDLELIGHT HOME.
THE OLD SPOOKY OLD LIGHTHOUSE STAYS EMPTY UNTIL A DISTANT BELL RINGS THREE TIMES THROUGH THE AUTUMN FOG.
WE FOLLOW A TRAIL OF CANDY PAST THE SPOOKY OLD LIGHTHOUSE, HOPING THE FRIENDLY GHOST WILL GUIDE US HOME.
